취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.

고용형태는 정규직으로 수습기간 12 주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.

당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.

recruitingops@coupang.com
) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.

jobs.description: Job Description Specialist, Data Stewardship The Opportunity: Join a global biopharma company with a 130-year legacy and mission to achieve new milestones in healthcare. Be part of technology driven, data-led organization supporting a diversified portfolio of medicines, vaccines and animal health products. Work alongside passionate teams that use data, analytics and insights to drive decisions, and tackle some of the world’s greatest health threats. Our Technology Centers are globally distributed hubs that enable our digital transformation and business outcomes across IT. They bring together diverse teams to collaborate, share best practices, and deliver solutions that save and improve lives. This role is based at our Hyderabad Tech Center and follows a hybrid working model (3 days per week in the office and 2 days remote). Candidates are expected to reside within a commuting distance of the Hyderabad office. Role Overview: The Specialist, Data Stewardship role plays a pivotal part in the creation, maintenance, accuracy, and compliant execution of master data supporting our company Manufacturing and Supply Chain operations, directly supporting business outcomes and ultimately impacting patients who rely on life-saving products. This is a global role supporting Manufacturing and Supply Chain master data processes. The Specialist is responsible for the accurate and timely execution of master data creation, extension, update, and maintenance requests. The role works closely with Data Steward Leads, ISO Stewards, Supply Chain stakeholders, and other relevant partners to ensure master data is established and maintained in accordance with global SOPs, work instructions, data standards, and business requirements. What will you do in this role Master Data Creation and Maintenance Execute master data creation, extension, update, and maintenance activities supporting Manufacturing and Supply Chain processes. Perform first-time material code creation, changes, and extensions, including required pre-checks and validation activities. Evaluate the appropriate parameters and data sets required to execute compliant and error-free master data changes within SAP ECC and SAP S/4. Ensure required information, prerequisites, documentation, and approvals are available before executing master data changes. Execute activities in accordance with global SOPs, work instructions, data standards, and established controls. Maintain complete and accurate evidence and documentation for all master data changes performed. Data Stewardship and Business Understanding Understand divisional requirements, business guidelines, and dependencies between master data elements and downstream processes. Work closely with Data Steward Leads, ISO Stewards, Supply Chain stakeholders, and other relevant teams to clarify requirements and ensure consistent execution. Identify incomplete, conflicting, or unclear requests and proactively engage or escalate to the appropriate stakeholder. Apply master data standards consistently across supported processes, locations, and business areas. Maintain a high level of accuracy, attention to detail, accountability, and timely execution. Data Accuracy and Continuous Improvement Perform proactive data accuracy checks and analysis to identify incorrect, incomplete, or inconsistent master data. Support investigation and correction of identified master data issues. Identify opportunities to automate, simplify, standardize, and improve master data processes and ways of working. Contribute ideas and operational expertise to continuous improvement within the Master Data Management organization. Additional responsibilities may include Support Supply Chain projects and business initiatives requiring master data creation, changes, extensions, or validation. Support Material Master Data change-control activities, including approvals, execution, documentation, and follow-up. Monitor relevant data reports and activities to help ensure records remain appropriately synchronized. Support testing and introduction of new or enhanced technology capabilities within Master Data Management. What should you have Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Information Technology, Data Management, Supply Chain, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. 2-3 years of experience in master data management, data stewardship, SAP master data, Supply Chain, or related operational roles. Primary skills (must-have) Strong practical knowledge of SAP master data processes, preferably SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4. Strong hands-on experience in master data creation, maintenance, extension, and change activities. Good understanding of Material Master Data and its role within Manufacturing and Supply Chain processes. Strong attention to detail and ability to execute complex data activities accurately and consistently. Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple requests, priorities, and deadlines. Proactive and solution-oriented mindset with strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to understand master data dependencies and the downstream impact of data changes. Strong stakeholder collaboration skills and ability to work effectively in a global, matrixed environment. Strong written and verbal English communication skills. Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel. Understanding of GxP principles and controlled working practices. Secondary skills (nice to have) Experience within the pharmaceutical, life sciences, or another regulated industry. Experience supporting Manufacturing and Supply Chain master data processes. Experience with DSP, Syniti, or similar master data tools. Experience supporting Supply Chain projects, product introductions, or network changes. Familiarity with master data governance and stewardship operating models. Experience with data validation, reconciliation, or synchronization activities. Who we are: We are known as well-known org Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and our company everywhere else. For more than a century, bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world. What we look for: Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today. jobs.description: About Our Company We’re a diversified financial services leader with more than $1.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year-end 2024. Our team of 22,000 people across 19 countries, serves more than 3.5 million individual, small business and institutional clients. We are a longstanding leader in financial planning and advice, a global asset manager and an insurer. Our unwavering focus on our clients and strong financial foundation connects each of our unique businesses – Ameriprise Financial, Columbia Threadneedle Investments and RiverSource Insurance and Annuities. Here, we foster meaningful careers, invest in the future, and make a difference for clients, institutions and communities around the world. Job Description Protecting clients from fraud and financial exploitation is at the core of this role. As an Investigator II, you will identify and analyze suspicious activity, fraud risks, policy violations, and financial crime concerns that impact clients and the firm. Using strong analytical and investigative skills, you will detect emerging threats, uncover critical insights, and take timely action to prevent losses and mitigate risk. This role plays a key part in safeguarding client assets, preserving the firm's reputation, and strengthening our fraud detection and prevention efforts. Key Responsibilities Conduct internal/external investigations of high risk compliance matters, financial fraud, and other sensitive/internal matters. Investigate low-to-medium risk matters relative to financial risk, scope, and complexity. Provide advanced investigative and analytic support, gather and track related information, and make appropriate recommendations. Complete data mining of internal and external systems to obtain appropriate supporting documentation. Complete basic data analysis to identify potential problems and mitigate risk throughout the firm. Work with clients and other departments on escalated and high-profile investigations. Analyze and interpret account transactions to identify fraudulent and suspicious activity. Take the necessary steps to detect fraudulent accounts, monitor for controlled addresses, and meet the requirements of the USA PATRIOT Act. Assist business and staff units to review and assess potential problems and risk exposures. Create, manage, and implement processes and procedures. Provide detailed subject matter support on projects. Maintain current knowledge of industry practices, developments, products, services and trends, including relevant laws and regulations related to fraud and compliance. Provide training to investigators on processes and other departments on emerging fraud trends. Required Qualifications Bachelors degree or equivalent (4-years) 3-5 years of relevant experience Demonstrated fraud, compliance, and investigative competencies. Experience handling general investigations. Solid knowledge of fraud, compliance, physical security, and relevant laws and regulations. Solid interviewing skills. Solid ability to manage, prioritize, and complete multiple tasks. Solid written and verbal communication skills. Solid analytical and problem-solving skills. Solid computer and software skills, including working knowledge of several internal systems from across the organization and product lines. Preferred Qualifications Facilitation skills. Working knowledge of Ameriprise products, services and business lines related to area of responsibility. In-Office Collaboration We are a client-centric, relationship-based business. Working together, in-person, is foundational to how we achieve results. By fostering a culture of face-to-face collaboration, idea sharing, productivity and personal connection, we deliver for our stakeholders — clients, advisors, employees and shareholders. Our employees work in the office at least four (4) days per week, with flexibility to work from home one (1) day per week. Some roles may require additional in-office time or different in-office expectations, and specific requirements will be discussed during the hiring process. Visa Sponsorship Applicants must have a valid work authorization that does not now, or in the future, require visa sponsorship for employment in the United States (e.g., H-1B, F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, TN). Base Pay Salary The estimated base salary for this role is $66,700 - $91,700 / year. We have a pay-for-performance compensation philosophy. Your initial total compensation may vary based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and geographical work location. In addition, most of our roles are eligible for variable pay in the form of bonus, commissions, and/or long-term incentives depending on the role. We also have a competitive and comprehensive benefits program that supports all aspects of your health and well-being, including but not limited to vacation time, sick time, 401(k), and health, dental and life insurances. 쿠팡이츠서비스(Coupang Eats Services)는 Delivery service에 대한 차별화 전략을 세우고, 쿠팡이츠의 고객, 상점주, 그리고 배달파트너들에게 한층 더 강화된 서비스와 지원을 제공하고 있습니다. 쿠팡이츠서비스는 원하는 음식을 언제 어디서든 빠르고 안전하게 배달함으로써 고객에게 놀라운 고객 경험을 선사하고, 상점주에게는 주문부터 배달, 고객응대까지 제공하는 원스톱 서비스를 통해 안정적인 판매 기회를 확보할수 있는 시스템을 운영하고 있습니다. 여러 분야의 전문가로 구성된 쿠팡이츠서비스는 하나의 팀으로서 고객과 상점주, 배달파트너가 원하는 가치를 고민하고 연구하며, 새로운 혁신과 패러다임 변화를 이끌어가고 있습니다.
쿠팡이츠(coupang eats)는 음식배달을 시작으로 장보기와 쇼핑까지 서비스 영역을 확장하며 고객의 일상을 더욱 편리하게 만드는 새로운 경험을 만들어가고 있습니다. 고객에게 더 나은 경험을 제공하기 위한 끊임없는 고민을 바탕으로 도전하며, 새로운 서비스와 카테고리의 변화를 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡이츠는 스스로 기회를 만들고 결과를 만들어낸 구성원에게 더 큰 역할과 책임을 부여하고 있습니다. 자신의 아이디어를 실행으로 옮기고, 성과를 통해 더 큰 기회를 만들어가며, 비즈니스의 성장을 직접 이끄는 성취감을 경험할 수 있습니다. 분야별 전문가들과 더 큰 도전을 통해 함께 성장하고 싶다면, 지금 쿠팡이츠와 함께하세요.
[팀 소개]
Merchant Engineering 팀은 한국 쿠팡이츠뿐만 아니라 글로벌 서비스(일반 로켓나우 등) 전반에 걸친 엔드투엔드(End-to-End) 상점주 여정(Merchant Journey)을 구축하고 혁신합니다. 우리는 상점주에게 필요한 시스템을 제공하여 지역 상점주들이 온라인 배달 모델에 쉽게 적응하고 성공적인 온라인 비즈니스를 운영할 수 있도록 지원합니다.
우리 팀은 입점(Onboarding), 메뉴 관리, 주문 처리, 정산, 매출 분석에 이르기까지 수십만 상점주가 비즈니스를 원활하게 운영할 수 있도록 돕는 핵심 플랫폼을 담당합니다. 상점주 및 고객이 위탁한 데이터의 주요 시스템을 소유하며, 고객은 정확한 매장 및 메뉴 정보를 바탕으로 최적의 선택을 하게 됩니다. 글로벌 비즈니스 확장과 빠르게 변화하는 커머스 환경 속에서, 우리는 주요 사업 관계자들과 긴밀히 협력하여 최상의 상점주 경험을 제공하고 있습니다. 동적이고 활력 있는 환경 속에서 뛰어난 문제 해결 능력을 발휘하며 함께 성장할 리더를 찾고 있습니다.
본 직무는 쿠팡 본사(Coupang Corp.) 소속 채용 건입니다.
주요 업무 (Key Responsibilities)
상점주 기술 전략 수립 및 실행:
한국 및 글로벌 상점주 플랫폼의 제품, 운영, 규제 요구사항을 실행 가능한 기술 로드맵으로 전환하고 이행을 주도합니다.
핵심 상점주 도메인 관리:
매장 입점, 메뉴/가격 관리, 주문 수락/상태 관리, 정산/매출 분석을 포함한 상점주 도메인 전반의 소프트웨어 개발 생애주기(설계, 개발, 테스트, 배포, 운영)를 총괄합니다.
아키텍처 리더십 및 시스템 안정성:
주요 기술 결정을 주도하고, 대규모 상점주 데이터를 안정적으로 처리할 수 있는 고가용성·고성능 백엔드 아키텍처를 설계합니다.
엔지니어링 우수성(Engineering Excellence):
코드 품질, 성능, 보안 기준을 수립하고 인시던트 관리, 온콜(On-call) 로테이션, 포스트모템(Post-mortem) 프로세스의 지속적인 개선을 이끕니다.
프로젝트 및 리소스 관리:
병렬로 진행되는 여러 프로젝트의 일정, 리소스, 리스크, 우선순위를 관리합니다.
팀 리더십 및 인재 육성:
백엔드 엔지니어의 채용, 코칭, 평가 및 커리어 성장을 지원하여 고성능 엔지니어링 조직을 구축합니다.
크로스 파트너십/협업:
프로덕트, 운영, 법무 및 글로벌 팀과 긴밀히 협력하여 요구사항을 조율하고 최선의 의사결정을 내립니다.
프로세스 및 생산성 혁신:
AI 기반 환경을 포함한 현대적 개발 방식 도입을 통해 팀의 엔지니어링 생산성과 시스템 운영 워크플로우를 구조적으로 개선합니다.
자격 요건 (Minimum Qualifications)
8년 이상의 백엔드 개발 경험 및 백엔드 엔지니어링 매니저 또는 테크 리드(Tech Lead)로서 입증된 리더십 경험
고트래픽 환경에서 대용량 분산 시스템 설계 및 마이크로서비스 아키텍처(MSA) 운영 경험 (성능, 안정성, 데이터 정합성, 보안 고려 필수)
복잡한 비즈니스 도메인(예: 매장, 정산, 상품/메뉴 관리 등)의 오너십을 갖고 시스템을 지속적으로 개선해 본 경험
운영 인시던트 대응, 모니터링 프레임워크 구축, 온콜 로테이션 관리를 포함한 서비스 SLA 유지 경험
복잡한 비즈니스 문제를 명확한 기술적 솔루션으로 전환할 수 있는 뛰어난 문제 해결 능력
글로벌 이해관계자 및 해외 엔지니어링 팀과의 원활한 협업을 위한 비즈니스 수준의 영어 소통 능력
우대 사항 (Preferred Qualifications)
Java 및 Spring Framework를 활용한 대규모 서비스 개발 및 운영 경험
다국어/다국가 서비스 운영 경험, 국가별 정산/세무 규제 대응 및 로컬라이제이션 주도 경험
B2B SaaS, 이커머스 상점주 플랫폼, 머천트 포털, 정산/결제 도메인 구축 경험
이벤트 기반 아키텍처(Event-Driven Architecture), 메시지 큐(Kafka 등), JPA/RDBMS/NoSQL 최적화 경험
조직 전체 및 인접 팀에 강력한 영향력을 미칠 수 있는 기술적 리더십
엔지니어링 품질 표준, 코드 리뷰 문화, 전반적인 개발 프로세스를 한 단계 끌어올린 경험
전형 절차
서류전형 - 리크루터 스크리닝콜 - 직무 적합성 인터뷰 - 핵심 역량 인터뷰 – 최종 합격
전형 절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다. 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
참고 사항
본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다. 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다. 보훈대상자 및 장애인 여부는 채용 과정에서 어떠한 불이익도 미치지 않습니다.

Company Description
CES (Coupang Eats Services) manages dedicated delivery partner operations and service teams that support customers, store owners, and delivery partners. We wow our customers by delivering what they want, when and where they want it. We also provide OSS (One-Stop Service) to help our restaurant partners connect with hungry customers by solving all types of problems related to our EDP (Eats Delivery Partners). If you are interested in redefining the future of food delivery, join us. With Coupang’s innovative technology, Coupang Eats Services will continue to offer delicious food to customers, empower local businesses, and generate new ways for delivery partners to earn, work, and live.
Team Description
The Merchant Engineering team is responsible for building and innovating the end-to-end Merchant Journey for Coupang Eats in Korea as well as global services (such as Rocket Now in Japan). We empower merchants and help potential local merchants to adapt to the online delivery model and support them to run successful online businesses.
Our team owns the core platform that enables hundreds of thousands of merchants to run their businesses smoothly—from onboarding and menu management to order processing, settlements, and sales analytics. Our team owns the key systems for the entrusted data from merchants and our customers rely on accurate store and menu information to choose the best to their needs. In an expanding global business and fast-changing commerce environment, we work closely with key business stakeholders to deliver the best possible merchant experience.
We are looking for a leader who can demonstrate exceptional problem-solving skills and grow within this dynamic environment.
This position is employed under Coupang Corp. (Headquarters).
Key Responsibilities
Merchant Technical Strategy & Execution:
Translate product, operational, and regulatory requirements across Korea and global merchant platforms into an actionable technical roadmap and drive execution.
Core Merchant Domain Management:
Oversee the full software development lifecycle (design, development, testing, deployment, and operations) across the merchant domain, including store onboarding, menu/pricing management, order acceptance/status management, and settlement/sales analytics.
Architecture Leadership & System Stability:
Lead key technical decisions and design high-availability, high-performance backend architectures capable of handling merchant data.
Engineering Excellence:
Establish standards for code quality, performance, and security. Drive continuous improvement in incident management, on-call rotations, and post-mortem processes.
Project & Resource Management:
Manage schedules, resources, risks, and task priorities across multiple parallel projects.
Team Leadership & Talent Development:
Build a high-performing engineering organization by recruiting, coaching, evaluating, and supporting the career growth of backend engineers.
Cross-Functional Collaboration:
Partner closely with Product, Operations, Legal, and global teams to align on requirements and make optimal trade-off decisions.
Process & Productivity Innovation:
Structurally improve team engineering productivity and system operational workflows by adopting modern development practices, including AI-driven environments.
Minimum Qualifications
8+ years of backend development experience, with proven leadership experience as a Backend Engineering Manager or Tech Lead.
Proven track record of designing distributed systems and operating Microservice Architectures (MSA) in high-traffic environments, with strong consideration for performance, stability, data consistency, and security.
Experience taking ownership of complex business domains (e.g., stores, settlements, product/menu management) and driving continuous system improvements.
Experience maintaining service SLAs, including production incident response, building monitoring frameworks, and managing on-call rotations.
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business problems into clear technical solutions.
Professional English communication skills for seamless collaboration with global stakeholders and international engineering teams.
Preferred Qualifications
Extensive experience developing and operating large-scale services using Java and the Spring Framework.
Experience operating multi-country services, accommodating country-specific settlement/tax regulations, and leading localization efforts.
Background in building B2B SaaS, e-Commerce Merchant Platforms, Merchant Portal, or settlement/payment domains.
Deep experience with Event-Driven Architectures, message queues (e.g., Kafka), and JPA/RDBMS/NoSQL optimization.

jobs.description: Aircraft Structures Technician (C-17) Company: Boeing Canada Operations Ltd Boeing Canada Operations Ltd . Global Technical Operations, Field Operations is looking for a highly skilled and experienced Aircraft Structures Technician , working out of the CFB Trenton, ON to support Canada Operational & Intermediate (O&I) Level Maintenance Augmentation Support Team (MAST) under the United States Government C-17 G3 Sustainment Contract. The Aircraft Structures Technician will work directly under the guidance of the Lead Structure Technician and report directly to the onsite Maintenance Manager. Position Responsibilities: Assembles, disassembles and/or modifies systems and components IAW applicable Technical Orders and regulations. Ensure timely repairs of maintenance activities ensuring the Customer aircraft is returned to service in a timely manner to the required standard meeting Boeing’s and Royal Canadian Air Force Airworthiness requirements. Meet individual training requirements for mandatory and non-mandatory training. Complies and Operates within a Safety Culture, First Time Quality, FOD Reporting, advising the Lead/Maintenance Manager of any compliance risk/escapes during Maintenance Operations. Works with the Quality/Safety Teams to address occurrences and audit findings in a timely manner. Ability to perform within the MAST and Squadron Maintenance as part of a cohesive team, working toward a common goal. Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience): 3+ years of experience as an Aircraft Structures Technician /Aircraft Mechanic, maintenance release authority (MRA), or equivalent to RCAF Level A. Knowledge of Royal Canadian Air Force operations and aircraft maintenance practices. Must have knowledge and use of special tools/equipment required to perform assigned maintenance tasks and the ability to interpret Technical Orders (TOs). Must have one of the following: Transport Canada Civil Aviation (TCCA) Aircraft Maintenance Engineer (AME) licensed S/M2 rating or Military equivalent. Must be legally able to work in Canada. Must be willing and eligible to work on Canadian government and defense-related programs with no restrictions. Must consent to Canadian Government Controlled Goods Program (CGP) assessment. Individuals must not pose a risk for safeguarding of controlled goods. Must be eligible for Secret Level II security clearance. Must be eligible to handle US export-controlled data. Preferred Qualifications (Education/Experience): 3+ years of experience with Canadian Aviation Regulations and Aircraft Airworthiness Directives. Canadian CC177 Globemaster III Type Course via Air Educational and Training Command (AETC) Department of Defense/Canadian Armed Forces Airworthiness Program Active Secret Level II security clearance.. Proven knowledge and proficiency in Excel, Word, Outlook and PowerPoint and the ability to learn in-house systems. Knowledge of Royal Canadian Air Force Electronic Record Keeping System (ERKS), current ERKS at 429 Transport Squadron is the Automated Data Aircraft Management (ADAM) system. Conflict of Interest: Successful candidates for this job must satisfy the Company’s Conflict of Interest (COI) assessment process. Additional Information: This requisition is for a locally hired position in Canada. The employer is Boeing Canada. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Canada. Benefits and pay are determined by Canada and are not on Boeing US-based payroll. This is not an expatriate assignment. The ability to work on a Canadian Government Federal Establishment (CFB Trenton) with no restrictions. Starting salary will be based on qualifications and experience. The range for this classification is CAD $95,000.00 - CAD $110,000.00 annually. This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a secret security clearance Level II from the Canadian government.
